verdict.rationale: The docs site has a structured API reference (per-endpoint pages like rich_search, local_pois, suggestions) and includes copy-pasteable curl examples, but there is no evidence of an interactive 'try-it' console or runnable code sandbox — probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec (a common backbone for interactive references) returned 404s. Missing for 10: evidence of a live/interactive request-runner UI, OpenAPI-based reference, or embedded runnable code examples beyond static curl snippets.
